status: unsigned candidate, not a release benchmark
comparison: installed signed Lean VS Code v0.7.0; internal historical comparison, not Code-OSS
method: Sum the desktop entry and every transitively static JavaScript output from the esbuild metafile. Count dynamic-import outputs separately. The packaged candidate uses production minification, NLS processing, and private-field conversion; the historical v0.7 installed app has one workbench JavaScript entry. These are JavaScript transfer/parse candidates, not measured startup latency, app-disk savings, or runtime-memory savings.

checks.leanCheckAi: passed; 87 of 87 main-thread extension API actors registered
checks.compactFunctionalSmoke: passed; edit/save, 401-file file search, 400-file text search, integrated terminal, Git diff, extension webview
checks.focusedStartupTrace: captured one candidate run; workbench import took 635 ms, versus 564 ms in an earlier non-paired control trace. Conditions and host load were not matched, so no causal latency conclusion follows.
